propositions: `.github/complexity-baseline.json` lacks a CI lock against `main`, allowing contributor changes to land without review, unlike `.github/module-size-limit.txt` which is protected in `_build-and-test.yml:363-373`

The baseline can grow silently: new high-complexity functions bypass the gate by adding matching baseline entries, because the current test guards schema and entry staleness but not entry count non-monotonicity
The module-size lock fails open on `git fetch` failure, running the cap against an unverified value from the current branch, allowing malicious raises to pass on fetch flakes
CI must semantically compare the baseline mapping against `main` and reject raised ceilings or added entries while permitting removed entries and lowered ceilings (shrink-only ratchet)
A new function above the C901 threshold must fail CI even when a baseline entry is added in the same change, preventing complexity from entering freely
